data.title: 角楯花凛 · 夏莱办公室的清扫小憩
data.description: 夏莱宽敞明亮的办公室内，午后暖融融的阳光洒在地板上。花凛双手端着盛有热红茶与手制点心的银色托盘，亭亭玉立在老师桌侧。听到老师由衷的一声称赞，这位身材修长高挑的冷艳狙击女仆耳尖泛红，难为情地微微偏过头去。
data.location: bright sunny Schale main office beside desk
data.action: holding silver tea tray, blushing head turn, tall maid posture, bashful smile
data.lighting: bright warm natural daylight streaming through tall glass windows
data.mood: endearing contrast and peaceful maid devotion
data.promptProse: Standing gracefully in a sunny office beside the desk holding a silver tea tray, Kakudate Karin blushes softly beneath her maid headband, looking away with endearing shyness.
data.animaCaption: Karin blushing while serving tea in the sunlit office.
